description: A Die & Mould Maker is an expert in process planning, manufacturing, and design of various dies and moulds, including press tools, jigs, fixtures, and die-casting dies. This role requires advanced skills in CNC programming and operation, CAD/CAM software, material analysis, and economic principles. Upon successful completion, learners will be qualified to become experts in the process planning, manufacturing, and design of dies & moulds, jigs & fixtures, press tools, and die casting dies. They will secure employment in engineering, manufacturing, machine tools, automobile, and all types of machinery industries, and also be equipped for entrepreneurship.
